response.description: In Microsoft Foundry, Guardrails helps developers configure runtime safety controls for agents, including classifiers, deterministic rules, and LLM-based judges.When an administrator policy requires controls for a project, Guardrails surfaces those requirements and prevents developers from changing policy-managed settings. Developers can still add permitted agent-specific controls.Policies can be reused across agents and models in a project, and existing guardrails remain backward compatible.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Updated Guardrails experience in Microsoft Foundry
